summary_markdown:
The team discussed the phased approach for implementing new features, starting with DOOH-21 and DOOH-22, followed by Google Street View integration (DOOH-24).

Regarding map functionality, it was decided that while Leaflet is the preferred library due to its extensive extensions, Google Maps must be used specifically for handling Street View data. A key requirement identified is the ability to draw lines, sectors, and polygons on a map.
decisions: Start development with DOOH-21 and DOOH-22 features.
Use Leaflet as the primary mapping library, but utilize Google Maps for Street View integration.
